indexes.name: social_authorization_history_account_id_revision_id_event_t_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX social_authorization_history_account_id_revision_id_event_t_key ON sutra.social_authorization_history USING btree (account_id, revision_id, event_type)

indexes.name: social_authorization_history_owner_time
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX social_authorization_history_owner_time ON sutra.social_authorization_history USING btree (user_id, recorded_at, id)

indexes.name: social_authorization_history_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX social_authorization_history_pkey ON sutra.social_authorization_history USING btree (id)

triggers.name: sutra_capture_social_authorization_history
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER sutra_capture_social_authorization_history AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.social_accounts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sutra.capture_social_authorization_history()

triggers.name: sutra_social_history_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER sutra_social_history_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON sutra.social_authorization_history FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION sutra.reject_social_history_mutation()

functions.name: capture_social_authorization_history
reject_social_history_mutation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sutra.reject_social_history_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUTRA_SOCIAL_HISTORY_APPEND_ONLY';
END $function$
